name: background-flow-field-lines
title: Flow Field
description: Các đường ngắn chảy theo hướng của một trường nhiễu, như gió, nước hay dòng dữ liệu.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 70 streamlines from seeded start points; each traced 14 steps of 4 px along angle = noise2(x x 0.012, y x 0.012 + t x 0.15) x 2 pi x 1.5, redrawn each frame so the field drifts; 1.4 px strokes, 1 in 7 accent, others grey. Recipe: position += (cos theta, sin theta) x speed, theta = noise(x, y). Params: count (70) · steps (14 × 4 px) · drift (0.15) · seed.
